name: Index YouTube Playlist

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at midnight UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      playlist_id:
        description: 'Override default YouTube Playlist ID'
        required: false
        default: ''
      force_reindex:
        description: 'Force reindex all videos (ignore cache)'
        required: false
        default: 'false'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  index-youtube:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Index YouTube Playlist
        env:
          # Required for YouTube API access
          YOUTUBE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.YOUTUBE_API_KEY }}
          
          # Required for Vectorize (Cloudflare)
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          VECTORIZE_INDEX_NAME: ${{ vars.VECTORIZE_INDEX_NAME || 'semantic-search' }}
          
          # Required for R2 (Cloudflare) manifest storage
          R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          R2_BUCKET_NAME: ${{ vars.R2_BUCKET_NAME || 'semantic-search-manifests' }}
          
          # Configuration
          YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_ID: ${{ github.event.inputs.playlist_id || vars.YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_ID }}
          FORCE_REINDEX: ${{ github.event.inputs.force_reindex || 'false' }}
          
          # Optional: Limit concurrency or specific settings
          NODE_ENV: production

        run: npx tsx scripts/index-youtube-playlist.ts

      - name: Notify on Failure
        if: failure()
        run: echo "YouTube indexing job failed. Check logs for details."
